title: Got new Apple gear on the way? Pick up these Beats USB-C cables (60% off)
content:
Macworld

Beats USB-C Cables (2-pack)

View Deal

Apple has a lot of new things to buy, and they all have one thing in common: cables, specifically USB-C cables. And if you’ve got some new stuff coming, you’re not going to want to use those old frayed cables anymore. Over at Amazon, you can get a two-pack of five-foot woven Beats cables for just $14. That’s just $7 a piece and a fantastic deal for excellent cables.

These cables may have the Beats logo on them, but that doesn’t mean you can only use them to recharge your Beats headphones. In fact, they’ll work with just about any device in your arsenal, from iPhones to AirPods and even your MacBook. The cables can push up to 60W of power, so they’re suitable for fast-charging a wide range of gadgets. You can even use them in a pinch to transfer data, though with USB 2.0 speeds, you’ll mostly want to stick to charging.

The Beats cables are covered in sturdy braided nylon so they’ll live through all the times you’ll coil them around your hand before throwing them at the bottom of the laptop bag. This also means they’re better prepared to survive the fraying that ruins so many cheap cables. Plus they’re longer than than the cables Apple supplies. At 5ft, you won’t have to be on the very edge of your bed while your iPhone is charging.

So, don’t miss out on the chance to grab these awesome Beats USB-C cables for $14 before the deal runs out.
